d:
An armed man allegedly hijacked a Mahindra XUV500 at gunpoint near Pathankot in Punjab on November 15. The incident has triggered a security alert across Punjab and Jammu and Kashmir, with police setting up checkpoints and searching vehicles along key highways. Investigators suspect the stolen SUV may have been taken towards Gurdaspur, but its exact location remains unknown. Security agencies fear it could be used in a major crime or terror attack. Is there a larger security threat behind this car robbery?
